facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Tunisia as having signed the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention) on 23/04/2019, with no date of ratification or accession and no date of deposit; 20 of 55 states have ratified or acceded.
